That’s where Shaffer Construction, Inc., a leading general and electrical contractor in Los Angeles, CA, comes into the picture. Our team comprises of highly skilled and experienced professionals who are dedicated to providing exceptional service. We specialize in a wide range of services, including electrical work, general construction, and most notably, the installation of electric vehicle chargers.

In addition to our services, we also believe in giving back to the community. We are actively involved in several community initiatives, demonstrating our commitment not only to our clients but also to the society we live in.

2. Our Expertise in EV Charger Installations

At Shaffer Construction, we have developed a deep understanding of the intricacies of EV charger installations. Our team is well-versed with different types of chargers, including Level 1, Level 2, and DC Fast chargers. We ensure that we stay updated with the latest advancements in EV charging technology, so we can provide our clients with the best solutions.

Our process for EV charger installations is thorough and meticulous. We begin by conducting a detailed assessment of your property to determine the most suitable location for the charger. We then design a custom installation plan, taking into consideration your specific needs and preferences.

We understand that the installation of an EV charger is a significant investment, and we are committed to providing our clients with the highest quality of service. We use top-grade materials and equipment to ensure that your charger is durable and reliable.

Our expertise in EV charger installations extends beyond residential properties. We also cater to commercial properties, providing businesses with efficient and cost-effective charging solutions. Whether you own a small business or a large corporation, we have the skills and resources to meet your EV charging needs.

Over the years, we have successfully completed numerous EV charger installations for both residential and commercial clients. The client needed several Level 2 chargers installed at their office building to cater to their employees’ growing use of electric vehicles. We designed a custom installation plan, taking into consideration the client’s specific needs and the property’s layout.
